subject: ist-f-dt
title: IST.F.DT.------PROG.CONT.
description: Diagram in PR.S(RD)II-8, on the page where Braxton argues that 'the science of a given form in black creativity has always followed the vibrational necessity of the invention and not the other way around. All of the extended harmonies practiced today were played in the early forms of the music — with the difference being that the notes were extended because of the vibrational reality of the individual, as opposed to the individual functioning as an extension of the notes.' IST-F-DT (isolated focus dictates) is crossed with PROG-CONT (progressional continuance): the question is what isolated-focus-dictates produces when crossed with progressional-continuance, in the context where black-music science follows vibrational necessity but is documented through western maneuvers that distort the actual reality. RT-ALGN (reality alignment) branches right from the main line and carries CULT-AF-B (culture affinity basis), which carries (R)INTR (the reality of interpretation), which carries LANG-CY. VT-DY (vibrational dynamics) branches right from the main line. C-CONT (composite continuance) branches down from the main line and carries T-C-IMP (time continuum implications), which carries MT-INFO (multi-information), which carries COS-P (cosmic particulars). PROG-CONT, the partner, is the structural endpoint.
